                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nThe ancient Greeks and Romans used to worship natural _______ as Gods and Goddesses.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "impulses"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "mixtures"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "instincts"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "elements"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'elements'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "elements" in this context refers to the fundamental constituents of the natural world. (प्राकृतिक दुनिया के मूलभूत घटक)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Ancient civilizations often personified natural forces like the sun, moon, water, fire, and earth as deities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The other options: "impulses," "mixtures," and "instincts" do not fit the historical and religious context of ancient Greek and Roman worship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Complete Sentence: The ancient Greeks and Romans used to worship natural elements as Gods and Goddesses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Impulses (आवेग): sudden strong urges or desires to act.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Mixtures (मिश्रण): substances consisting of two or more components mixed together without chemical bonding.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Instincts (सहज वृत्ति): innate, typically fixed patterns of behavior in animals in response to certain stimuli.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n214:Td4e,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is: Option 4.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Let's analyze each sentence to determine the grammatically correct option:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 1) The traffic on a highway was heavy during an evening.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • While "a highway" is grammatically correct, "an evening" is less natural. We usually refer to a specific part of the day with "the" when it's implied or understood.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2) The traffic on the highway was heavy during the evening.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "The traffic" is appropriate as traffic is generally considered a singular mass noun in this context. "The highway" implies a specific highway, which is natural. "During the evening" is the standard and grammatically correct way to refer to that part of the day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This sentence is grammatically and contextually correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3) The traffic on the highway was heavy during an evening.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Similar to option 1, "an evening" is less natural than "the evening."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 4) A traffic on the highway was heavy during an evening.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • "Traffic" is generally an uncountable noun, so it doesn't typically take the indefinite article "a." We say "heavy traffic," not "a traffic." Also, "an evening" is less natural.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Based on the analysis, option 2 uses the articles "the" appropriately for both "traffic," "highway," and "evening" in this context.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the grammatically correct sentence is:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The traffic on the highway was heavy during the evening.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nI am calling to thank you _______ the present you sent.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "for"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "with"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "of"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "in"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is 'for'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The preposition "for" is used to express the reason or purpose of an action (thanking).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It indicates what the gratitude is directed towards (the present).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Options 2, 3, and 4 are incorrect prepositions to use after the verb "thank."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Complete Sentence: "I am calling to thank you for the present you sent."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: "with" is used to indicate accompaniment or means, which is not appropriate in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 3: "of" is often used to show possession or origin, neither of which fits the meaning of the sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: "in" typically indicates location or time, which is irrelevant to expressing gratitude for a gift.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Fill in the Blanks"], "concept": "Fill in the Blanks", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "6758105f9ad473bc36d343e8", "qs_no": 17, "pos_marks": 3.0, "neg_marks": 1.0, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "Select the option that expresses the given sentence in future perfect tense form.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \nI hope you wash all the clothes before you come into the house again.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "I hope you will have washed all the clothes before you come into the house again."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "I hope you shall wash all the clothes before you come into the house again."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "I hope you will be washing all the clothes before you come into the house again."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "I hope you will have wash all the clothes before you come into the house again."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The future perfect tense is used to describe an action that will be completed before a specific time in the future.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The structure of the future perfect tense is: will/shall + have + past participle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the given sentence, the action of washing all the clothes is expected to be completed before the action of coming into the house again.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 1, "I hope you will have washed all the clothes before you come into the house again," correctly uses the future perfect tense ("will have washed") for the first action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Correct Sentence: "I hope you will have washed all the clothes before you come into the house again."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 2) I hope you shall wash all the clothes before you come into the house again. – This option uses the simple future tense ("shall wash"), not the future perfect. While "shall" can be used for the future, "will" is more common in modern English for most subjects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 3) I hope you will be washing all the clothes before you come into the house again. – This option uses the future continuous tense ("will be washing"), which describes an ongoing action in the future, not a completed one before another future action.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • 4) I hope you will have wash all the clothes before you come into the house again. – This option incorrectly uses the base form of the verb "wash" after "will have." The past participle ("washed") is required for the future perfect tense.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
